title: A Clean Sweep
overview: Amateur baseball players go up against legendary pros in a championship to determine the ultimate winning team.

title: Agents of Mystery
overview: Six "agents of mystery" with excellent chemistry probe into bizarre incidents that cannot be explained by science in creative and unique ways.

title: Ainori Love Wagon: African Journey
overview: To find love, seven strangers leave Japan and embark on a journey through the African continent.

title: Badly in Love
overview: In Japan's first dating show for rebellious yankiis, 11 singles butt heads, forge bonds and live together for 14 days as they go all out to find the one.

title: Better Late Than Single: After Service
overview: The eternal singles of season 2 are back! The final couples give updates, and a truth game lays bare behind-the-scenes secrets and unspoken feelings.

title: Chef & My Fridge
overview: The best chefs of Korea compete to create impromptu dishes that feature ingredients found inside the guest stars' personal refrigerators.

title: Crime Scene Zero
overview: In this mystery showdown, players engage in layered scenarios as either suspects or detectives — each striving to outsmart others and uncover the truth.

title: Culinary Class Wars
overview: Eighty "Black Spoon" underdog cooks with a knack for flavor face 20 elite "White Spoon" chefs in a fierce cooking showdown among 100 contenders.

title: Final Draft
overview: Twenty-five athletes, most retired, compete to win 30M yen to launch their second career. Can they overcome tough physical and psychological challenges?

title: J-Style Trip
overview: Megastar Jay Chou joins his A-list friends in this globe-trotting variety show packed with music and magic tricks.

title: Jae-seok's B&B Rules!
overview: The guest is king — but so is the host! Yu Jae-seok opens his first B&B, where he runs things his way and treats guests to his signature games.

title: K-foodie meets J-foodie
overview: Korea's top foodie Sung Si-kyung joins Japan's beloved Yutaka Matsushige on a tasty adventure as they explore culinary gems across Korea and Japan.

title: Kian's Bizarre B&B
overview: On a remote island, Kian84 hosts a quirky B&B escape, where BTS' Jin and Ji Ye-eun lead guests through playful exploits and delightful chaos.

title: Korea No.1
overview: Yu Jae-seok, Lee Kwang-soo and Kim Yeon-koung travel all over Korea to learn from the best traditional masters in a bid to become the No. 1 Apprentice.

title: Love After Divorce
overview: Newly single and ready to mingle, divorced men and women enter the Dolsing Village looking to date, cohabitate and find love again.

title: Love Deadline
overview: Looking for true love, women meet potential husbands while traveling to scenic locales. The catch? Only women can propose, while men are on the clock.

title: Love Is Blind: Japan
overview: In this reality dating series, marriage-minded singles in Japan meet, date and get engaged — before ever setting eyes on each other.

title: Love Village
overview: Singles 35 and over of various backgrounds relocate to a house in the countryside for another chance at love. Will they find "the one" — or leave alone?

title: Nineteen to Twenty
overview: A group of young adults share their last week of teens and first week of twenties together — experiencing freedom and all the “firsts” of adulthood.

title: Offline Love
overview: Young singles spend ten days in a foreign country, relying on fate alone to fall in love. Without any digital devices, will they be able to find the one?

title: Physical: 100
overview: One hundred contestants in top physical shape compete in a series of grueling challenges to claim the honor — and cash reward — as the last one standing.

title: Physical: Asia
overview: Elite athletes from eight countries battle for national pride. After grueling tests of raw strength and endurance, only one flag can claim victory.

title: Ready or Not: Texas
overview: No plans, just vibes. When two best friends and their crew set off for Texas on an entirely unscripted adventure, there's no telling what's coming next.

title: Restaurant War Street King Thailand
overview: Thailand's best street food chefs face off against one another. With a life-changing cash prize and the chance of a professional career at stake, who will emerge as the ultimate winner under the guidance of experienced chefs?

title: Rugged Rugby: Conquer or Die
overview: In the shadows of Korea's rugby world, seven teams engage in a fierce battle of strength, strategy, and teamwork — all vying to be crowned champion.

title: Run for the Money
overview: In a race with time, celebrity contestants desperately try to outmaneuver black-clad Hunters in pursuit, for a chance to win a growing cash prize.

title: Single's Inferno Reunion
overview: "Single's Inferno" contestants reunite to reveal honest feelings and relationship updates — revisiting standout moments from their time on the island.

title: Take a Hike!
overview: Four celebrity hiking newbies end up forming a club to tackle Korea's snow‑capped peaks. Can they figure out why on earth people go to the mountains?

title: Terrace House: Boys & Girls in the City
overview: A new set of six men and women start their lives together under one roof. All they get is a fabulous home and a car. As always, there is no script.

title: Terrace House: Opening New Doors
overview: The bright young people of Terrace House return to Japan, where they live together and face new relationship challenges.

title: Familiegeheimen: The Boyfriend
overview: Louise is involved in a near-miss but is saved by Elias, a true hero. What begins as a fairy tale soon turns into a game of manipulation. Who is Elias really? And what are his intentions for Louise?

title: The Devil's Plan
overview: It's the ultimate showdown of wits, brains, strategy, and alliances for a chance to win 500 million won.

title: The Gentlemen's League
overview: An amateur football reality show produced by JTBC, featuring teams made up of former athletes and celebrities and coached by former national team football players under the leadership of Ahn Jung-hwan. Throughout each season, the teams train, develop their skills, and compete in various tournaments and matches in pursuit of victory.

title: The Hungry and the Hairy
overview: On the motorbike road trip of their dreams, buddies Rain and Ro Hong-chul relax and unwind as they delight in tasty eats and scenic locales around Korea.

title: The Influencer
overview: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram — 77 elite influencers flaunt their skills to strategically draw the most attention in this high-stakes social survival show.

title: The Love Lab
overview: An innovative dating experiment reality show that breaks away from the conventions of traditional dating programs. Unfamiliar men and women are placed in extreme and controlled environments, facing unexpected experiments such as blind dates in bed and romances in isolation. Through unpredictable situations, the show dynamically captures the participants' raw, instinctive emotions and the realistic changes in their relationships.

title: Three Idiots in Kenya
overview: Once a far-off promise, now a reality — three buddies finally hit the road in Kenya. Get ready for adventure, banter and maybe even a giraffe selfie.

title: Zombieverse
overview: A zombie virus outbreak has run amok in Korea — who will outwit the undead in the face of challenging quests and come out alive?
